assumptions.choice: Consolidation state is verified on the previous candle (close[-1] between $180.00 and $193.00) prior to the breakout candle closing above $193.00.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines consolidation as range $180.00–$193.00 and breakout entry signal as current close > $193.00, requiring the preceding bar to have been inside the consolidation zone.

assumptions.choice: Selling volume during consolidation is evaluated on the previous bar if it was a down candle (close[-1] < open[-1]), verifying volume[-1] <= 1.5 * SMA20(volume)[-1].
assumptions.reason: Spec requires selling volume during consolidation pullback to not exceed 1.5 times the 20-day average daily volume.
infeasible: Fundamental news and earnings report events are not present in standard OHLCV backtest data, as noted directly in the specification.

assumptions.choice: Risk is set to 1% of portfolio equity per trade, calculating position size as risk_amount / (entry_price - 180.00) capped by available cash.
assumptions.reason: Spec requires position sizing such that potential stop-loss loss does not exceed 1-2% of total trading capital.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit triggers when high[0] >= $200.00 or close[0] >= $200.00; stop-loss and alternative exit trigger on candle close < SMA120[0] or close < $180.00.
assumptions.reason: Aligns with specified exit rules and standard backtrader market exit convention.
